formula.source: NASA CR-1457 eq 2.2-12 and 2.2-13, printed page 2-33
formula.statement: sigma_wr = 0.82 * (Ec*tf/(eta*Ef*tc))**0.5 * (eta*Ef) / (1 + 0.64*K_delta); K_delta = delta*Ec/(tc*Fc); elastic eta = 1. That is Q = 0.82 / (1 + 0.64*K_delta) in sigma = b*Q*sqrt(Ef*Ec*tf/tc).
formula.biaxial_statement: R_x**3 + R_y = 1. Equal compression gives r**3 + r = 1.
formula.figures_from: MIL-HDBK-23, as named on the CR-1457 page
